purpose: Priority-state 2026 unemployment-insurance facts checked against the state agency's own page on lastReviewed. These override the DOL Significant Provisions base rate because they include employer surcharges/assessments the DOL table excludes (its footnote 3). Rates are percent of taxable wages.

surcharges.name: Administrative Funding Assessment
surcharges.sourceName: DC Department of Employment Services — Reporting Questions

DC.sourceName: DC Department of Employment Services — Tax Rate Questions
DC.note: New employers pay the higher of 2.7% or the prior-year average contribution rate; DOL lists 2.70% for 2026. Same standard rate for construction.

MD.sourceName: Maryland Department of Labor — Unemployment Insurance Tax Rates (Table A in effect for 2026)
MD.note: Maryland Labor states 2026 new-employer rates range 1.0%–2.6%; DOL lists 2.60% as the 2026 new-employer base rate. Out-of-state construction contractors pay the Maryland construction average.

VA.sourceName: Virginia Employment Commission — How are tax rates assigned?
VA.note: VEC: new employers receive a 2.5% initial base rate 'plus add-ons'. The 2026 add-on percentages were not published on a VEC page we could verify, so they are NOT included — the real rate is likely somewhat higher.

CA.sourceName: California EDD — Rates and Withholding (2026: Schedule F+, new employers 3.4%)
CA.note: SDI (1.3% in 2026) is withheld from employees, not an employer cost, and is excluded.

TX.sourceName: Texas Workforce Commission — Tax Rates (2026 entry-level rate 2.70% for all NAICS groups)
TX.note: TWC's rate is the sum of its components (GTR, replenishment, obligation assessment, deficit, ETIA); the 2.70% entry rate is the total.

FL.sourceName: Florida Department of Revenue — Reemployment Tax
FL.note: Initial rate 2.7% on the first $7,000 per employee.

surcharges.name: Re-employment Service Fund
surcharges.sourceName: New York State Department of Labor — Unemployment Insurance Rate Information

NY.sourceName: New York State Department of Labor — Unemployment Insurance Rate Information (2026 new employer: 4.025% UI + 0.075% RSF = 4.1%)
NY.note: UI rate = normal rate (3.4% for new employers in 2026) plus subsidiary rate. Wage base $17,600 also listed by DOL Significant Provisions July 2026.

surcharges.sourceName: Ohio Department of Job and Family Services — 2026 Rate Details

OH.sourceName: Ohio Department of Job and Family Services — 2026 Rate Details (new business 2.7%; new construction 5.7%; +0.15% fee)
OH.note: Effective new-business rate 2.85%; new construction-business rate 5.85%.
